item.title: Saudi Arabia Confirms First Day Of Ramadan
item.description: Saudi Arabia announced the sighting of the crescent moon. Thus, tomorrow will be the first day of Ramadan. Earlier, it was announced that the moon-sighting would take place in Hawtat Sudair and Tumair in Al-Majma’ah Governorate. item.description: A Saudi appeals court has ruled that an Egyptian woman is entitled to a share of her late husband’s estate worth more than 150 million riyals (around 1.8 billion Egyptian pounds), concluding a high-profile inheritance dispute involving a Saudi businessman. item.title: Some Saudi Cities Barely Felt Winter Cold This Year
item.description: Hussain Al-Qahtani, spokesman of the National Center for Meteorology (NCM), said that some cities in the Kingdom have barely felt the winter cold this year. He noted that the weather has been warmer than usual due to the concentration of cold air masses, primarily over the central and northern regions. item.description: The Transport General Authority (TGA) has arrested two foreign nationals for operating road transport activities without a valid license, known locally as “kaddad,” and applied penalties that include deportation and fines of up to SR12,000. item.title: Saudi: Over 2,850 Endangered Birds Recorded Wintering At King Salman Royal Reserve
item.description: The King Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority recorded more than 2,850 rare raptor species wintering within the reserve, reinforcing its importance as a refuge for endangered species. item.title: UAE Weather Forecast: Fair Skies With Early Fog Risk Through Sunday
item.description: The UAE will experience fair to partly cloudy weather today, the first day of Ramadan, with humid conditions developing overnight and into Thursday morning, and a probability of fog or mist over some western areas, according to the National Centre of Meteorology (NCM).
